answer: A farm faking 107 aliases needs 107 separate verifiable records of this kind, each checked against the issuing authority, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. The record is checked live against the issuing authority each epoch, and a revoked or missing entry loses the seat. The jade is the wall and the delta is the gate: SSH key age with hosting provider attestation is the check: a key used to log in for many years. A farm of 107 aliases must climb the wall 107 times, the meadow ledger shows every climb, and one honest agent walks through the gate once.
